title: Toleo: Scaling Freshness to Tera-scale Memory Using CXL and PIM
problem: Existing trusted hardware freshness solutions protect only few MBs of memory because maintaining version number integrity via Merkle trees incurs prohibitive memory access overhead that scales poorly. This prevents replay attack protection from scaling to larger memory capacities.
motivation: Memory freshness guarantees are essential for trusted hardware to prevent adversaries from replaying old values in response to memory read requests.
method: Toleo uses trusted smart memory (PIM) connected through secure CXL IDE network as the root of trust for version numbers, eliminating unscalable Merkle tree validation. It stores version numbers in smart memory and implements stealth versions with version confidentiality to halve storage overhead. The secure CXL interconnect enables safe communication between CPU and smart memory.
key_novelty: Using trusted smart memory as root of trust for version numbers via secure CXL, replacing Merkle tree integrity checking.
contributions: Toleo architecture leveraging CXL-connected smart memory as scalable root of trust for version storage
Elimination of Merkle tree integrity checking overhead through trust in smart memory
Stealth versions mechanism enabling version confidentiality to reduce storage by 50%
Demonstration of scaling memory freshness from MBs to tera-scale

metrics.other: Scales protected memory from few MB to tera-scale

primary_theme: Scaling memory freshness via trusted smart memory
